policy: Retain warning-blocking full-scope checks; suppress only file/rule combinations with reviewed semantics.

reviewed_exceptions.reason: These includes() calls search substrings inside strings. Exact Set membership would change script discovery, settings-path matching, and sitemap exclusions.
Overflow relations are fetched in batches of 50 through the rate-limited delivery client. Preserve bounded outstanding work and fail-fast behavior. This mirrors the existing root transport exception.

The preview fixture access is inside an Astro browser-only script. The product-description fixture contains deliberately malicious HTML as a string to test sanitization; it is not executed server code. Neither fixture page is shipped in the package.

Locale navigation depends on Auth0 client session data after mount. Browser origin is an SDK initialization option, not a DOM/render branch; Auth0 renders the same initial loading state on both sides. The installed SDK captures options in a useState initializer, so delaying origin through a hydration store loses the login callback URI. Preserve the existing initialization rather than introducing an authentication regression.
